in_marathi.name: Aparjita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aparjita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Aparjita is a Sanskrit word composed of 'a-' (not) and 'parjit' (conquered). The name signifies one who cannot be conquered or defeated. In Hindu mythology, Aparjita is the name of a goddess and a heroine.
